name: sensor_faults
step: README step 9: one approach sensor fails during traffic (stuck, crash, hang)
seeds: sensor noise seeds are the lg-sensor defaults, (dir * 3 + id + 1) * 2654435761, the same in every run
notes: Times are plant times in ms. Trains strike in at 20, 60, 100, 150, 180, 220 s (west, east alternating), reach the island at 36, 78, 113, 166, 196, 234 s and the gate is UP again (2 s T_clear, 4 s travel) at about 47, 91, 123, 179, 207, 245 s.
end_ms lies after the gate of the last counted train is UP and before the next train strikes in, so the end state is level 0, gate UP, lights off.
expect_trains: trains that reach the island before end_ms. expect_level: highest level after the boot release.
clear_ms 0: the fault clears itself (crash and hang: the supervisor restarts the sensor).

expect_diag: the diagnosis of the URGENT maintenance ticket for the faulty sensor (alternatives separated by |); NONE = no ticket at all. Crash and hang race: the controller may see the sensor silent first or the supervisor RESTARTING status first.
